info.title: Zoho Analytics API (v1)
info.description:
The Zoho Analytics (formerly Zoho Reports) HTTP API, version 1.0: data (add/update/delete rows, import, export, CloudSQL), modeling (workspaces, tables, columns, lookups, views), metadata, sharing and groups, embed URLs and slideshows, and user management, plus the Zoho Accounts OAuth token endpoints and the white-label SSO endpoints the same reference documents.

v1 is action-driven: every request targets a resource URI (/api/{ownerEmail}[/{workspaceName}[/{viewName}]]) and the operation is chosen by the ZOHO_ACTION query parameter. Plain OpenAPI cannot key two operations on one path+method, so each action is its own path key with the discriminator after a '#' (e.g. /api/{ownerEmail}/{workspaceName}/{viewName}#ZOHO_ACTION=ADDROW); the request sent on the wire is the path before the '#' with ZOHO_ACTION in the query string.

The OpenFn zoho adaptor's addRow() calls POST https://reportsapi.zoho.com/api/{account}/{db}/{table}?ZOHO_ACTION=ADDROW with the legacy `authtoken` query parameter (the legacyAuthtoken scheme); current docs use OAuth via the Authorization header and the analyticsapi.* hosts.

servers.description: Zoho Analytics API server for your data centre.
Legacy Zoho Reports host, still answering v1 requests; the host the OpenFn adaptor hard-codes.

post.summary: Add a row to a table
post.description:
Adds a single row. Column values are sent as further form fields named after the table's columns (`<columnName>=<value>`). This is the operation the OpenFn adaptor's addRow() calls.

Zoho Analytics API v1 action `ADDROW` (OAuth scope `ZohoAnalytics.data.create`). Docs: https://www.zoho.com/analytics/api/v1/data-api/add-row.html

ZOHO_DATE_FORMAT.description: Date format of date values, e.g. dd-MMM-yyyy.

additionalProperties.description: Column value, keyed by the table's column name.

post.description: Zoho Analytics API v1 action `DELETE` (OAuth scope `ZohoAnalytics.data.delete`). Docs: https://www.zoho.com/analytics/api/v1/data-api/delete-data.html

ZOHO_CRITERIA.description: Filter criteria (SQL WHERE-like); all rows are deleted when omitted.

ZOHO_VALID_JSON.description: true returns JSON with proper escaping; default false.

ZOHO_CALLBACK_FUNCTION.description: JSONP callback function name (JSON output only).

post.description:
Updates rows matching ZOHO_CRITERIA. New column values are sent as further form fields named after the columns.

Zoho Analytics API v1 action `UPDATE` (OAuth scope `ZohoAnalytics.data.update`). Docs: https://www.zoho.com/analytics/api/v1/data-api/update-data.html

ZOHO_CRITERIA.description: Filter criteria; all rows are updated when omitted.

ZOHO_VALID_JSON.description: true returns JSON with proper escaping; default false.

additionalProperties.description: Column value, keyed by the table's column name.

post.description: Zoho Analytics API v1 action `IMPORT` (OAuth scope `ZohoAnalytics.data.update`). Docs: https://www.zoho.com/analytics/api/v1/data-api/import-data.html

ZOHO_FILE.description: The CSV or JSON file to import (multipart/form-data). Send either ZOHO_FILE or ZOHO_IMPORT_DATA.

ZOHO_IMPORT_DATA.description: The data to import as a string, instead of ZOHO_FILE.

ZOHO_IMPORT_TYPE.description: APPEND, TRUNCATEADD (delete all then add) or UPDATEADD (update matching, add the rest).

ZOHO_ON_IMPORT_ERROR.description: What to do on a row error.

ZOHO_CREATE_TABLE.description: Create the table if it does not exist; default false.

ZOHO_MATCHING_COLUMNS.description: Comma-separated columns used to match rows; required when ZOHO_IMPORT_TYPE is UPDATEADD.

ZOHO_SKIPTOP.description: Rows to skip from the top.

ZOHO_IMPORT_JSON_RETCOLNAMES.description: JSON imports only: how column names are derived from nested keys; default false.

ZOHO_COLUMN_DATEFORMAT.description: URL-encoded JSON object mapping column name to date format.

ZOHO_COMMENTCHAR.description: Rows starting with this character are skipped (when ZOHO_AUTO_IDENTIFY is false).

ZOHO_DELIMITER.description: 0 comma, 1 tab, 2 semicolon, 3 space (when ZOHO_AUTO_IDENTIFY is false).

ZOHO_QUOTED.description: 0 none, 1 single quote, 2 double quote (when ZOHO_AUTO_IDENTIFY is false).

post.description:
Exports a table, report or dashboard. ZOHO_OUTPUT_FORMAT additionally accepts CSV, PDF, HTML and IMAGE for EXPORT; those return the file body (text/csv, application/pdf, text/html, image/*) rather than the JSON envelope modelled here.

Zoho Analytics API v1 action `EXPORT` (OAuth scope `ZohoAnalytics.data.read`). Docs: https://www.zoho.com/analytics/api/v1/data-api/export-data.html

ZOHO_CRITERIA.description: Filter criteria; all rows are exported when omitted.

ZOHO_SQLQUERY.description: A literal SQL SELECT used as the export query.

GENERATETOC.description: Dashboards only: generate a table of contents.

ZOHO_DASHBOARD_LAYOUT.description: Dashboards only: 0 each report on a new page, 1 layout as in dashboard.

ZOHO_INCLUDE_HEADER.description: CSV: include column names in the first row.

ZOHO_PAPERSIZE.description: PDF: 0 letter, 1 legal, 2 tabloid, 3 A3, 4 A4, 5 auto.

ZOHO_EXPORT_LANGUAGE.description: PDF: 0 English, 1 Chinese, 2 Japanese, 3 European, 4 Korean.

ZOHO_HEAD_LEFT.description: PDF header/footer: 0 blank, 1 title, 2 date/time, 3 page number, 4 page x of y, 5 custom.

ZOHO_HEAD_RIGHT.description: PDF header/footer: 0 blank, 1 title, 2 date/time, 3 page number, 4 page x of y, 5 custom.

ZOHO_HEAD_CENTER.description: PDF header/footer: 0 blank, 1 title, 2 date/time, 3 page number, 4 page x of y, 5 custom.

ZOHO_FOOT_LEFT.description: PDF header/footer: 0 blank, 1 title, 2 date/time, 3 page number, 4 page x of y, 5 custom.

ZOHO_FOOT_RIGHT.description: PDF header/footer: 0 blank, 1 title, 2 date/time, 3 page number, 4 page x of y, 5 custom.

ZOHO_FOOT_CENTER.description: PDF header/footer: 0 blank, 1 title, 2 date/time, 3 page number, 4 page x of y, 5 custom.

ZOHO_HEAD_LEFT_TEXT.description: Custom header/footer text when the matching setting is 5.

ZOHO_HEAD_RIGHT_TEXT.description: Custom header/footer text when the matching setting is 5.

ZOHO_HEAD_CENTER_TEXT.description: Custom header/footer text when the matching setting is 5.

ZOHO_FOOT_LEFT_TEXT.description: Custom header/footer text when the matching setting is 5.

ZOHO_FOOT_RIGHT_TEXT.description: Custom header/footer text when the matching setting is 5.

ZOHO_FOOT_CENTER_TEXT.description: Custom header/footer text when the matching setting is 5.

ZOHO_VALID_JSON.description: true returns JSON with proper escaping; default false.

ZOHO_CALLBACK_FUNCTION.description: JSONP callback function name (JSON output only).

KEY_VALUE_FORMAT.description: JSON: return rows as {data: [{column: value}]} instead of column_order/rows.

post.summary: Run a CloudSQL SELECT query over a workspace
post.description:
Zoho CloudSQL: the EXPORT action at workspace level with ZOHO_SQLQUERY executes a SQL SELECT across the workspace's tables. Non-JSON output formats (CSV, PDF, HTML, IMAGE) return the file body.

Zoho Analytics API v1 action `EXPORT` (OAuth scope `ZohoAnalytics.data.read`). Docs: https://www.zoho.com/analytics/api/v1/zoho-cloudsql/cloudsql-api-specification.html

ZOHO_SQLQUERY.description: URL-encoded SQL SELECT statement; may join tables of the workspace.

ZOHO_VALID_JSON.description: true returns JSON with proper escaping; default false.

ZOHO_CALLBACK_FUNCTION.description: JSONP callback function name (JSON output only).

KEY_VALUE_FORMAT.description: JSON: return rows as key/value objects.
